exposure: MRI features (e.g., 'loss of T2-retroplacental line', 'myometrial thinning', 'bladder vessel sign', 'uterine/placental bulge', 'focal exophytic placental mass')
history of prior deliveries (vaginal or caesarean section)
cohort: The study included 131 pregnant women (mean age 36 years, mean gestational age 28 weeks) who underwent MRI for placental or fetal indications between 2016 and 2021.
finding: A multivariable model combining 'uterine/placental bulge,' 'focal exophytic placental mass,' and 'bladder vessel sign' demonstrated good performance (AUC = 0.83) for diagnosing placenta accreta spectrum disorders.
mod_finding: History of prior deliveries, including both vaginal and caesarean section, was associated with placenta accreta spectrum disorders.
